message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts: Transfer of arcade business, purchase and placement of "打鱼机" (fishing game machines) which have gambling function, providing gambling venue and equipment, illegal profit 150 yuan, self-surrender. Likely crimes: "开设赌场罪" (illegal gambling - operating a casino) under Chinese criminal law. Also possibly "非法经营罪"? But the main is "开设赌场罪" (operating a gambling establishment). Also "非法经营罪" could be for operating gambling equipment without license. However Chinese law: Article 303 of Criminal Law: "开设赌场的，处三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或者管制，并处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" Also "非法经营罪" is for illegal business activities that cause serious loss. But gambling is specifically covered by opening a casino. So the appropriate charge: "开设赌场罪". Also maybe "赌博罪"? Actually "赌博罪" is for participants, not operators. Operators are charged with "开设赌场罪". So answer: [罪名]开设赌场罪<eoa>.

Check if any other crimes: "非法获取国家税收"? No. "非法转让经营权"? Not a crime. So only one.

Thus final.
